opening_message:

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E007.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:

  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Kenneth Burch (E007) is a contractor Analyst. No advanced security training on record. As a contractor, write requires advanced security training; without it, maximum is read. Recommend read for Payroll.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Kenneth Burch (E007) is a contractor Analyst with basic (not advanced) security training. As a contractor, write requires advanced training; without it, maximum is read. Requested write to Payroll is above maximum, so recommend read for Payroll.
reason: Kenneth Burch (E007) is a contractor with basic (not advanced) security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; since advanced training is not on record, the maximum level for Payroll is read. The requested write exceeds this maximum, so grant the maximum of read.
